Indexes this by 28-byte stride a2 to select one wheel record, stores two contact/state flag bytes at byte offsets 15224 and 15225 of that record, then copies a 3-dword vector from a5 into byte offset 15240 and returns a pointer to the copied vector.

Return result (pointer to v5 + 15240, the copied 3-dword vector).
